BOWMAN AUCTIONS
Details for BOWMAN AUCTIONS
BOWMAN AUCTIONS SAT., MARCH 28, 2026 9:00 AM OPEN HOUSE: FRIDAY 9:00-4:00 LOCATION: 680 Waterman Drive, Harrisonburg, Va. 22802 We will sell the following: Guns: 1922 FN Browning’s patent 32 ACP 7.65mm, S&W 38 cal., 1940 German Luger, Marlin Mod.17Vs cal.17 H.M.R., Lock 44USA 221R, Revelation mod.350 H .410 bore, Hellcat Springfield Armory, Taurus .357 Mag., Ruger LCP 380 Auto, Puma 12 ga., Glenfield mod.60 cal. 22 LR, Harpers Ferry mod. 1816 lock 1828, Murtimer Fowler shotgun, Gamo Bone collector 975 cal. 5.5 (.22) w/scoop, Shadow systems 9mm, RTS mod.1966 cal.22, Ruger single six .22 cal., Ruger .32 H&R mag., new model single six, Ruger .22 cal. Single six 22 mag, Shadow systems MR 920L, Shadow systems 9mm, Kimber Pro Cary II, Bear bow, Excalibur bow, Bow and arrows, 2014 Ford Escape (90,00 miles) John Deere 2555 w/ 245 bucket , 5’ county line rotary cutter, Collectibles: Elk Lithia bottle, License plate collection, local advertisements, Fenton, Jim Shore, Fenton, carnival & depression glass, crocks, Elkton elementary school plate, Fulks service station calendar, Mac’s Superette calendar, Broadway year books, Longaberger baskets, milk glass, adv. yard sticks, Green bear water jug w/ wood container, Denim days collection, model cars, Pepsi cola truck, Rainbow wrecker truck, trading cards, vintage dicer collections, salt sellers, Cracker Jack sign, Winross truck, Chicken on nests, condiment set, Books: “Shenandoah Voices, Hobby Robinson books, cookbooks (local), The Heartland, Golden books, Caterpillar tractor parts book, Furniture: stereo cabinet, dressers, sofa & matching chair, Curio cabinet, kitchen chairs, drop leaf side table, lamps, chairs, shaving mirror stand, patio tables & chairs, Miscellaneous: Craftsman stackable toolbox, Mighty Auto parts cabinets, Toro zero turn, small trailer, 35 Hp. Air compressor, Liberty safe (18guns), Herring Hall safe, safe, Miami sun 3 wheeled bicycle, 22 ton log splitter on trailer, 2 bottom John Deere plow, ExMark Turf Rake, Sears air compressor, hand & yard tools, Winnie the Pooh items, Cast iron skillets & irons, trunks, U.S. trunk, binoculars, scrapbooking items, welding & cutting set , Lathe, much more. Household: Maytag dryer, Grant Crest set of china, Dept. 56 collection, Pyrex dishes & carriers, Amber glass, Tupperware, Revere ware cookware, corning ware, flatware, Christmas, NO BUYERS PREMIUM!! FOOD WILL BE SERVED. Terms of Personal Property sale: cash or check w/ID or credit card. Announcements made the day of sale take precedence over all written material. AUCTIONEER: Col. Jack Bowman #185
